evidence.quote: The programme is designed for international and German applicants alike and is taught entirely in English, with selected courses available in German as an option.
Non-EU/EEA Citizens EUR 1,500 EUR 211 EUR 1,711 Tuition fee based on passport nationality

Foreign and stateless prospective students with a higher education entrance qualification obtained abroad (except EU citizens) can apply directly to the desired degree program via the applicant portal.
You must first submit your school leaving certificate for recognition (via International Programs Office or Studienkolleg Konstanz).

notes: Duplicated tuition evidence on the hs-pforzheim.de/bdbm page says non-EU/EEA citizens pay EUR 1,500 tuition per semester plus EUR 211 administrative fee (total EUR 1,711 per semester). The DAAD page states "Tuition fees per semester ... non-EU countries 1,500 EUR". The programme duration quote says 7 semesters, which equals 3.5 years. The application deadline is for the winter semester (starting end of September or early October); the year is inferred from the target winter semester 2026/27, giving 31 May 2027 — the quote itself does not state the year. For applicationChannel, the university's international admission page says foreign applicants apply directly via the applicant portal; documents may also be sent to the Center for International Students in Konstanz for recognition, but this is not uni-assist, so de-university-direct is used. The documents fact is limited to the one document (school-leaving certificate) explicitly named for non-EU applicants in the quoted sentence; the pages do not state a translation requirement for this programme, so translationRequired is null.
